issues.description: Behavior change: coerceNumber silently maps null/NaN to 0 instead of producing NaN
issues.detail: The original panLinear/zoomLinear used toNumber (which returns null for empty string and NaN for non-numeric), so domain[0]=null produced NaN propagation. The new coerceNumber returns 0 for null, silently converting invalid input into a numeric 0 and changing observable output. This is not 'same runtime behavior' as the PR claims.

issues.description: panLog/zoomLog read domain[0] before the empty-check, defeating the guard
issues.detail: panLog and zoomLog call Math.sign(domain[0]) before invoking pan/zoom. For an empty domain, domain[0] is undefined, so Math.sign returns NaN and log(NaN) is computed before the isNonEmpty check throws. The guard should live in the public functions, or domain[0] access should happen after the check.

issues.description: New runtime error is a breaking change not reflected in semver/changelog
issues.detail: The PR description admits a new runtime error is thrown for empty domains, where previously the functions returned [NaN, NaN] or similar without throwing. Any downstream caller that relied on silent NaN behavior (common in plotting pipelines that filter NaN later) will now crash. This warrants at minimum a changelog note and likely a minor/major version bump.

issues.description: Domain return type [number, number] may contain NaN/Infinity without acknowledgment
issues.detail: The Domain tuple type implies valid finite numbers, but log(sign) applied to a zero-crossing or sign-mismatched domain produces NaN, and pow with negative exponents can produce Infinity. The type is technically correct (NaN is a number) but misleading for consumers relying on types.

issues.description: peek overload ordering may not narrow as intended for readonly tuples
issues.detail: The overloads declare readonly [T, ...T[]] first returning T, then readonly T[] returning T|undefined. Since the implementation signature returns T|undefined, callers passing a NonEmptyArray<T> (non-readonly mutable tuple) should match the first overload, but the readonly modifier in the overload may prevent that match for mutable [T, ...T[]] arguments.

issues.description: Missing test coverage for panLog/panPow/panSymlog/zoomLog/zoomPow/zoomSymlog empty-domain cases
issues.detail: Only panLinear and zoomLinear have new tests for empty domains. The log/pow/symlog variants compute Math.sign(domain[0]) before the guard runs (see P1 above), so they have different observable behavior that should be tested or fixed.

review.summary: This PR converts transform.js to TypeScript and adds an empty-domain runtime guard, but two issues conflict with the "same runtime behavior" claim. First, coerceNumber returns 0 for null where the original toNumber returned null (propagating to NaN), a silent behavior change. Second, panLog/zoomLog read domain[0] for Math.sign before the empty-check runs, so the guard doesn't actually protect those paths. The new error throw is also a breaking change that warrants changelog/semver attention. Empty-domain test coverage is incomplete.
